'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Josh Mack LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Josh "Remaker" Mack
* '''Deck name:''' Return of the Mack
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
